about.tagline: Redefinindo o gerenciador de downloads de código aberto
about.open-source-acknowledgement: {label}: Agradecemos a AnInsomniacy por desenvolver o projeto de código aberto Rayburst. O Rayload é um porte não oficial para Android, mantido de forma independente e publicado sob a licença GPL-3.0.
about.disclaimer:
Rayload is an open-source, tracking-free download tool. Any content obtained through built-in plugins (such as cloud-drive parsing) is unrelated to the developers; please comply with the relevant cloud-drive terms of service.

Rayload 是一款开源、无追踪的下载工具。任何基于本软件内置插件（如网盘解析）获取的内容，均与开发者无关，请遵守相关网盘的服务条款。

legal.technical-body: Rayload only provides P2P and HTTP download technology. It does not store, provide, index, or distribute any downloadable content. All content is downloaded directly from third parties chosen by the user.
legal.copyright-body: Users must ensure they own the rights to, or are otherwise legally authorized to download, all content. Using Rayload to download pirated software, films, music, or other infringing material is strictly prohibited.
legal.lawful-body: Rayload must not be used to distribute malware, illegal information, or to violate any applicable local law or regulation.
legal.liability-body: Any legal dispute or copyright claim arising from the use of Rayload is the sole responsibility of the user. The developers accept no joint or vicarious liability.
legal.privacy-local-body: Rayload has no account system and no telemetry. Task history, settings and logs stay on your device unless you choose to export or share them.
legal.privacy-tracking-body: Rayload does not collect analytics, advertising identifiers, or personal information. Update checks contact the release source only to compare version numbers.
legal.privacy-lan-body: LAN pairing exchanges connection details only between devices you explicitly pair. Data is sent directly over your local network and is not uploaded to a developer server.

whats-new.title: What's new
whats-new.1-0-4-lan: LAN devices: pair phones and tablets, send tasks remotely, and aggregate duplicate addresses per device.
whats-new.1-0-4-history: Statistics: all-device history totals, trends and per-category breakdowns, with live sparklines.
whats-new.1-0-4-permission: Android 17 local network permission is now requested in-app and listed in Permission settings.
whats-new.1-0-4-settings: Settings are reorganized: Downloads, BitTorrent, ED2K and Network share one Downloader page; file categories have their own page.
whats-new.1-0-4-wizard: Setup wizard now includes navigation customization, floating-orb options and the user agreement.
